goal: Fix the native AUX Arb Rules tab layout so BUYOUT/BID/Save/Reload controls occupy a dedicated header row and never overlap BUYOUT/BID rule fields on 768p or scaled UI layouts.
shared_resources: AuxVmangos native AUX Arb Rules UI
notes: User screenshot showed the Arb Rules top action buttons overlapping the BID master/vendor/DE/resell checkboxes and first-row fields. Root cause: rule pages were SetAllPoints() to the full AUX frame while the action buttons were anchored to aux.frame.content, so the two coordinate systems collided. This UI-only fix creates a dedicated header anchored to aux.frame.content and anchors BUYOUT/BID pages 34 px below it. No BID/BUYOUT thresholds, defaults, transaction logic, scanning, valuation, or auction execution behavior changes. ECONOMY delivery is required; one /reload is expected because this is TOC-loaded addon Lua. No gameplay/UI success is claimed before user test.
